Because the river cluster is derived from funding history, the split is applied at settlement and the cipher audit lists each share. The reward pool is divided per detected cluster rather than per key, so 179 linked identities split one share instead of collecting 179 of them. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
